questions.question: Before his brothers left Egypt, Joseph had his steward put something in Benjamin's sack. What was it?
Joseph's steward said that all of the brothers would become slaves if the cup was found in any sack. True or false?
When Joseph's silver cup was found in Benjamin's sack, what did Judah say God had done?

answers.text: Sent the famine as a warning
Sent the steward to test them

questions.question: Judah pleaded with Joseph to spare Benjamin. What did Judah ask Joseph to do?

answers.text: Keep Judah as a slave instead of Benjamin
Let the brothers buy Benjamin back later
Take double the silver for Benjamin
